# 9. Harmonized Bacillota/Bacteroidota ratio

The Bacillota/Bacteroidota ratio is retained as a secondary exploratory analysis. It is calculated independently in each cohort from the corresponding rarefied **phylum-level** abundance table. Historical phylum names are harmonized (`Firmicutes` to `Bacillota`; `Bacteroidetes` to `Bacteroidota`). The inferential outcome is the natural logarithm of the ratio after adding a transparent 0.5-count pseudocount to both phyla; the untransformed ratio is also exported for descriptive use. The same Stage 1 and Stage 2 covariate structures are used as in the other within-cohort models. A null result is retained and reported rather than used as a reason to omit the analysis.

```{r fb-ratio-functions}
FB_PSEUDOCOUNT <- 0.5

phylum_token_match <- function(labels, token) {
  labels <- stringr::str_to_lower(as.character(labels))
  labels <- stringr::str_replace_all(labels, "firmicutes", "bacillota")
  labels <- stringr::str_replace_all(labels, "bacteroidetes", "bacteroidota")
  stringr::str_detect(labels, paste0("(^|[^a-z])", token, "([^a-z]|$)"))
}

prepare_fb_ratio <- function(phylum_mat, meta, cohort_key, source_file) {
  if (is.null(phylum_mat) || !nrow(phylum_mat) || !ncol(phylum_mat)) {
    stop("Phylum table is empty for ", cohort_key, ".", call. = FALSE)
  }

  taxa <- rownames(phylum_mat)
  bacillota_ix <- phylum_token_match(taxa, "bacillota")
  bacteroidota_ix <- phylum_token_match(taxa, "bacteroidota")

  if (!any(bacillota_ix) || !any(bacteroidota_ix)) {
    stop(
      "Could not identify both Bacillota and Bacteroidota in the phylum table for ",
      cohort_key, ". Bacillota rows: ", sum(bacillota_ix),
      "; Bacteroidota rows: ", sum(bacteroidota_ix),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  aligned <- align_feature_to_meta(phylum_mat, meta)
  mat <- aligned$feature

  bacillota_count <- colSums(mat[bacillota_ix, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  bacteroidota_count <- colSums(mat[bacteroidota_ix, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  total_count <- colSums(mat, na.rm = TRUE)

  data <- tibble(
    sample_id = aligned$common,
    cohort = cohort_config[[cohort_key]]$cohort,
    cohort_key = cohort_key,
    bacillota_count = as.numeric(bacillota_count),
    bacteroidota_count = as.numeric(bacteroidota_count),
    total_phylum_count = as.numeric(total_count),
    bacillota_relative = dplyr::if_else(total_count > 0, bacillota_count / total_count, NA_real_),
    bacteroidota_relative = dplyr::if_else(total_count > 0, bacteroidota_count / total_count, NA_real_),
    fb_ratio_raw = dplyr::if_else(bacteroidota_count > 0, bacillota_count / bacteroidota_count, NA_real_),
    fb_ratio_pseudocount = (bacillota_count + FB_PSEUDOCOUNT) / (bacteroidota_count + FB_PSEUDOCOUNT),
    log_fb_ratio = log(fb_ratio_pseudocount),
    source_file = source_file
  )

  diagnostics <- tibble(
    cohort = cohort_config[[cohort_key]]$cohort,
    cohort_key = cohort_key,
    source_file = source_file,
    n_samples = nrow(data),
    n_bacillota_rows = sum(bacillota_ix),
    n_bacteroidota_rows = sum(bacteroidota_ix),
    bacillota_labels = paste(taxa[bacillota_ix], collapse = " | "),
    bacteroidota_labels = paste(taxa[bacteroidota_ix], collapse = " | "),
    n_zero_bacillota = sum(data$bacillota_count == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_zero_bacteroidota = sum(data$bacteroidota_count == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_finite_log_ratio = sum(is.finite(data$log_fb_ratio))
  )

  list(data = data, diagnostics = diagnostics)
}

run_fb_preference_models <- function(fb_df, meta, cohort_key, stage_label) {
  if (is.null(fb_df) || !nrow(fb_df)) return(tibble())

  common <- intersect(fb_df$sample_id, rownames(meta))
  if (length(common) < 5) return(tibble())

  meta2 <- meta[match(common, rownames(meta)), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(meta2) <- common
  fb2 <- fb_df[match(common, fb_df$sample_id), , drop = FALSE]

  design <- build_model_design(
    meta2,
    cohort_key = cohort_key,
    stage = stage_label,
    include_preferences = TRUE
  )
  fb2 <- fb2[match(rownames(design), fb2$sample_id), , drop = FALSE]

  dat <- dplyr::bind_cols(
    tibble(outcome_value = numify(fb2$log_fb_ratio)),
    design
  )
  pref_terms <- preference_terms(meta2)

  fit <- tryCatch(
    stats::lm(
      stats::reformulate(names(design), response = "outcome_value"),
      data = dat,
      na.action = stats::na.omit
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      warning(
        "Bacillota/Bacteroidota model failed for ", cohort_key, "/", stage_label,
        ": ", conditionMessage(e), call. = FALSE
      )
      NULL
    }
  )
  if (is.null(fit)) return(tibble())

  broom::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      cohort = cohort_config[[cohort_key]]$cohort,
      cohort_key = cohort_key,
      stage = stage_label,
      outcome = "log(Bacillota/Bacteroidota)",
      n_samples = stats::nobs(fit),
      pseudocount = FB_PSEUDOCOUNT,
      model_terms = paste(names(design), collapse = "; "),
      is_preference = term %in% pref_terms
    )
}
```

```{r fb-ratio-analysis}
if (RUN_FB_RATIO) {

  fb_community_obj <- prepare_fb_ratio(
    features$community_phylum,
    meta_community,
    "community",
    cohort_config$community$rarefied_tables$phylum
  )

  fb_student_obj <- prepare_fb_ratio(
    features$student_phylum,
    meta_student,
    "student",
    cohort_config$student$rarefied_tables$phylum
  )

  fb_ratio_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    fb_community_obj$data,
    fb_student_obj$data
  )

  fb_ratio_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    fb_community_obj$diagnostics,
    fb_student_obj$diagnostics
  )

  fb_model_results_raw <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    run_fb_preference_models(
      fb_community_obj$data,
      meta_community,
      "community",
      "stage1"
    ),
    run_fb_preference_models(
      fb_community_obj$data,
      meta_community,
      "community",
      "stage2"
    ),
    run_fb_preference_models(
      fb_student_obj$data,
      meta_student,
      "student",
      "stage1"
    ),
    run_fb_preference_models(
      fb_student_obj$data,
      meta_student,
      "student",
      "stage2"
    )
  )

  fb_preference_adjusted <- fb_model_results_raw %>%
    dplyr::filter(is_preference, is.finite(p.value)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cohort, stage) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      q_fb = stats::p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(cohort, stage, term, q_fb)

  fb_model_results <- fb_model_results_raw %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      fb_preference_adjusted,
      by = c("cohort", "stage", "term")
    )

  fb_preference_results <- fb_model_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(is_preference) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      preference = unname(PREFERENCE_LABELS[term]),
      preference = dplyr::if_else(
        is.na(preference),
        term,
        preference
      )
    )

  fb_preference_summary <- fb_preference_results %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cohort, stage) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_tests = dplyr::n(),
      n_nominal = sum(
        p.value < NOMINAL_THRESHOLD,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      n_fdr = sum(
        q_fb <= FDR_THRESHOLD,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  fb_preference_fdr_hits <- fb_preference_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(q_fb),
      q_fb <= FDR_THRESHOLD
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(q_fb, p.value)

  save_table(
    fb_ratio_data,
    "fb_ratio_harmonized_sample_data.csv"
  )

  save_table(
    fb_ratio_diagnostics,
    "fb_ratio_harmonized_diagnostics.csv"
  )

  save_table(
    fb_model_results,
    "fb_ratio_stage1_stage2_all.csv"
  )

  save_table(
    fb_preference_results,
    "fb_ratio_preference_associations.csv"
  )

  save_table(
    fb_preference_summary,
    "fb_ratio_preference_summary.csv"
  )

  save_table(
    fb_preference_fdr_hits,
    "fb_ratio_preference_fdr_hits.csv"
  )

  fb_plot_df <- fb_preference_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(estimate),
      is.finite(conf.low),
      is.finite(conf.high)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      cohort = factor(
        cohort,
        levels = c(
          "Community cohort",
          "Student cohort"
        )
      ),
      stage_label = factor(
        stage,
        levels = c("stage1", "stage2"),
        labels = c("Stage 1", "Stage 2")
      ),
      preference = factor(
        preference,
        levels = names(PREFERENCE_COLORS)
      ),
      nominal = p.value < NOMINAL_THRESHOLD
    )

  if (nrow(fb_plot_df) > 0) {

    p_fb_ratio_preferences <- ggplot(
      fb_plot_df,
      aes(
        x = estimate,
        y = forcats::fct_reorder(preference, estimate),
        colour = preference,
        shape = nominal
      )
    ) +
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = 0,
        linetype = 2,
        colour = "grey60"
      ) +
      geom_errorbar(
        aes(
          xmin = conf.low,
          xmax = conf.high
        ),
        orientation = "y",
        width = 0.16
      ) +
      geom_point(size = 2.0) +
      facet_grid(
        cohort ~ stage_label,
        scales = "free_y",
        drop = FALSE
      ) +
      scale_colour_manual(
        values = PREFERENCE_COLORS,
        drop = FALSE
      ) +
      scale_shape_manual(
        values = c(
          `FALSE` = 1,
          `TRUE` = 16
        ),
        labels = c(
          `FALSE` = paste0(
            "P >= ",
            NOMINAL_THRESHOLD
          ),
          `TRUE` = paste0(
            "P < ",
            NOMINAL_THRESHOLD
          )
        )
      ) +
      labs(
        x = "Coefficient for log Bacillota/Bacteroidota ratio",
        y = NULL,
        colour = "Preference",
        shape = "Nominal association"
      ) +
      fig_theme(base_size = 8.5)

    save_figure(
      p_fb_ratio_preferences,
      "fb_ratio_preference_associations_supplement",
      width = 9.4,
      height = 7.2,
      out_dir = SUPP_DIR
    )

    print(p_fb_ratio_preferences)

  } else {

    p_fb_ratio_preferences <- NULL
    message(
      "No finite Bacillota/Bacteroidota preference estimates available for plotting."
    )
  }

  knitr::kable(fb_ratio_diagnostics)
  knitr::kable(fb_preference_summary)
  knitr::kable(fb_preference_fdr_hits)

} else {

  fb_ratio_data <- tibble::tibble()
  fb_ratio_diagnostics <- tibble::tibble()
  fb_model_results <- tibble::tibble()
  fb_preference_results <- tibble::tibble()
  fb_preference_summary <- tibble::tibble()
  fb_preference_fdr_hits <- tibble::tibble()
  p_fb_ratio_preferences <- NULL

  message(
    "Bacillota/Bacteroidota ratio analysis disabled by run_fb_ratio: false"
  )
}
```
